title: OR-Select: Reproducible Best-of-N Answer Selection over LLM Ensembles, with an Exact Kemeny Reference and a Ground-Truth Audit
description: Code, stored run files (candidates, judge outputs and graded results) for every track except GPQA Diamond, generated tables and pre-registration documents accompanying the manuscript. The GPQA Diamond run files embed password-gated question text and are not included; they are regenerated by the released scripts.
